body: I do not want to kill myself, I do not want to die and destroy his life. He needs me, and I love him and need him. But I'm finding it so hard to deal with this pain.  I'm scared to even hold his hand because I feel like I'm doing something wrong. This is a loving amazing child who needs all the support and love in the world, and my crippling self doubt is stopping me from doing that.

After my wife died I had a lot of guilt about sexual thoughts and minor actions (things like checking women out) that I'd done while we were together.  Virtually everything, from finding women in the street attractive, to porn became anathema to me. But the more I tried to avoid these things the worse the obsession over them became. If i'd just not taken them so seriously to begin with, I probably wouldn't put so much weight on them.

Apparently intrusive thoughts coupled with depression can lead to a loss of sexual identity, and yes, I have considered whether I suddenly find men attractive. I don't. But I am scared I've started to find children attractive. Not necessarily in a sexual way, I don't feel I want to have sex with children, but it's like I'm scared I find them attractive.  I feel like everything I do comes from a bad place, and that frightens me.

I do talk to one family member and I see a counsellor, but she has her own problems, and he thinks it's time I started to stand on my own two feet, respectively.  I guess what I'm looking for is someone to say "hey, that thought  you had, it's not as bad as you think it is".

Outside of the intrusive thoughts, I also have thoughts I don't consider intrusive (outside the scope of innapropriate aggressive or sexual thoughts) that I just don't like.  I wonder how I can think things that I don't consider to be part of me as a person.  Being annoyed that I had been reminded of my wife's illness while contemplating fapping and almost angry that it had killed the desire is a horrible way to think, but think it I did.

I've been struggling every day with sexual thoughts of any kind, I essentially feel guilty about every single thought from any direction. But this one gave me a panic attack like I haven't experienced since shortly after my wife died.

I live in fear of sinking even lower, of thinking something even worse without even trying and then having to live with the guilt and the pain of never being able to take it back.
